scope: Segment DL6 host-originated, separator-free, self-delimited ('\' ... '~') daily store-and-forward blocking window, sent only as Data Block No. 4 of a Table Load Response when Segment DL1 carries Card Type 173
extractionEvidence: regression-artifact-validator/specifications/ATL105/docs/specs/extracted_text.txt lines 17532-17585 (Section 12.47), 9180-9236 (Section 11.7.1.2 Data Block No. 4), 23956-23964 (Section 13.2 Element 166), Appendix E Card Type 173

rules.title: Segment DL6 is only sent in a Table Load Response when Segment DL1 (Merchant Data Segment) includes a Card Type value of 173 in Data Element No. 14 (Card Type)
rules.note: Confirms SEGDL1-R-005. DL6 without Card Type 173 in DL1, and Card Type 173 without DL6, are both errors.

rules.title: Segment DL6 maximum length is 9 alphanumeric characters; originates at BUYPASS (Host); Data Type Indicator fixed '\' (field 1), End-of-Data Indicator fixed '~' (last field)
rules.note: PROVISIONAL: the four fields sum to 10 ('\' + 4 + 4 + '~'), not 9 (SEGDL6-SME-003). Field 1's description ('software IP load data follows') and Element 34's segment list (DL1-DL5 only) are also inconsistent with DL6 (SEGDL6-SME-004).

rules.title: Start Time and End Time both use Element 166 and format HHMM, defining the window during which store-and-forward processing is blocked
rules.note: PROVISIONAL (SEGDL6-SME-001). Evidence for intentional reuse: Element 166 is named 'Start Time or End Time'. Evidence against completeness: its purpose and processing rules mention only custom receipt text / host discount data in Segment 118, not DL6.

rules.title: Segment DL6 fields are not separated by Field Separators; when a field is not populated, the next field immediately follows
rules.note: Both times are Required and fixed width, so DL6 parses by position.

rules.title: Start Time and End Time (Element 166) are numeric, fixed length four digits HHMM, valid values 0000-2359

Segment DL6 is Data Block No. 4 of the Table Load Response: it follows the End-of-Load Indicator '*' that closes Data Block No. 3 and is itself followed by an End-of-Load Indicator '*'; it is sent only on a Table Load Response
rules.note: Whether '*' appears both before and after DL6 is open under SEGDL1-SME-003.

rules.title: Card Type 173 'Enables Store and Forward blocking for a designated range of time each day'; the DL6 Start Time and End Time define that daily recurring window during which the device blocks store-and-forward processing
rules.note: Window semantics across midnight, Start = End and time-zone basis are open (SEGDL6-SME-005).
